# uitars-mcp — Full LLM Documentation

## Project Overview

uitars-mcp is a desktop GUI agent MCP server that exposes natural language computer
control as MCP tools. It wraps the UI-TARS vision-language model (or any
OpenAI-compatible VLM) in a screenshot→action→execute loop.

## Architecture

Single uvicorn process serves:
- FastAPI REST API on port 10976
- FastMCP HTTP endpoint at /mcp
- Vite + React frontend on port 10977 (proxies /api and /mcp to 10976)

## MCP Tools

1. uitars_execute(task, max_steps=15) — Full GUI task execution
2. uitars_screenshot() — Capture desktop as base64 PNG
3. uitars_click(x, y, button="left") — Click at coordinates
4. uitars_type(text) — Type text at current focus

## REST API

- GET  /api/health       — Backend readiness
- GET  /api/status        — VLM model health + info
- GET  /api/screenshot    — Current desktop capture
- POST /api/execute       — Execute GUI task {task, max_steps}
- *    /mcp               — FastMCP HTTP endpoint

## Configuration (Environment Variables)

| Variable | Default | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| UITARS_PORT | 10976 | Backend port |
| UITARS_FRONTEND_PORT | 10977 | Frontend port |
| UITARS_VLM_BASE_URL | http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 | VLM endpoint |
| UITARS_VLM_MODEL | qwen2.5-vl:7b | Model name |
| UITARS_VLM_API_KEY | ollama | API key |
| UITARS_MAX_STEPS | 15 | Max action steps |

## VLM Providers

- Ollama (local): qwen2.5-vl:7b — ~5.5GB VRAM
- vLLM (local): UI-TARS-1.5-7B — ~14GB VRAM (FP16)
- Anthropic API: claude-sonnet-4-20250514 — no GPU needed
- OpenAI API: gpt-4o — no GPU needed

## Prompt Template

Uses UI-TARS COMPUTER_USE prompt. Actions: click, double_click, right_click,
drag, hotkey, type, scroll, wait, finished.

## Dependencies

Python: fastmcp>=3.2, fastapi>=0.115, uvicorn, httpx, ui-tars, mss, pyautogui, pillow
Node: react 18, vite 5, typescript 5.6
